5. The tracked-receipt test must fail if the artifact is missing; remove the skip and assert existence.
6. Add focused negative tests for METS identity/title/bitstream drift and HTML identifier/bitstream drift, re-pinning fixture hashes as needed so the semantic checks—not the byte hash alone—reject the mutation.
7. Preserve all existing fail-closed gates and the exact 13-page-vs-294-page distinction. No source-fitness judgment, topic narrowing/closure, training, ingest, semantic gold, Phase 3 completion, or Phase 4 authorization.
